# PlatformIO Core version floor for CI.
#
# platform-espressif32's develop branch (platform.json tool-scons 4.41101.0)
# requires PlatformIO Core >= 6.2.0 (SCons 4.11.1). A core/tool-scons version
# mismatch makes the platform wipe ~/.platformio/packages/tool-scons mid-build,
# which kills the linker step with ModuleNotFoundError:
# SCons.Tool.FortranCommon (pioarduino/platform-espressif32#529).
# Keep this in sync with the core tag pinned in the "Install PlatformIO Core"
# workflow step; drop when pioarduino ships a compatible release asset.
pioarduino>=6.2.0
